subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add a distinct soft-steer contract that interrupts an active generation and transparently continues it with new user input, beyond existing boundary `steer` and replacement `interrupt` modes?
rationale: The request combines two currently separate runtime primitives and requires product choices for partial output, tool cancellation, continuation identity, and unsupported backends.

options.title: Design soft steer
options.body: Define a cross-runtime lifecycle covering pause or abort, transcript handling, injected input, continuation, and fallback semantics.

options.title: Keep current primitives
options.body: Treat boundary steering plus explicit interrupt-and-replace as the supported contract and close the broader request after documenting that decision.

options.title: Harness-specific capability
options.body: Offer transparent continuation only for runtimes that prove native same-turn support, with conservative fallback elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Design soft steer
recommendation.body: Define a cross-runtime lifecycle covering pause or abort, transcript handling, injected input, continuation, and fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent lifecycle-aware steering work makes this person the strongest available owner for the product and runtime choice.
